summary: Produce the 2-D t-SNE scatter plot of high-amplitude whole-brain coactivation events coloured by brain state, by embedding the event × region matrix with t-SNE, clustering the embedding with HDBSCAN, reassigning noise points to their best-correlating cluster centroid in the original region space, relabelling clusters by descending size, and drawing them as red/blue/black point clouds with colour-matched legend text.
use_when: Run the t-SNE state-space scatter of coactivation events recipe

Produce the 2-D t-SNE scatter plot of high-amplitude whole-brain coactivation events coloured by brain state, by embedding the event × region matrix with t-SNE, clustering the embedding with HDBSCAN, reassigning noise points to their best-correlating cluster centroid in the original region space, relabelling clusters by descending size, and drawing them as red/blue/black point clouds with colour-matched legend text.
avoid_when: A low-dimensional embedding alone would be treated as confirmatory statistical evidence
